name: Divine Sense
description: Until your next turn ends, your senses reveal celestials, fiends and undead within 60 ft, except any with total cover. You learn each one's type, not its identity. You also notice consecrated or desecrated places and objects in range.
Uses: 1 + your Charisma modifier. A long rest restores them all.

name: Lay on Hands
uses: Pool refills on a long rest
description: You have a healing pool of 5 x your paladin level hit points, refilled by a long rest. As an action, touch a creature and spend points from the pool to heal it by that amount.
Or spend 5 points to cure a disease or neutralize a poison on the target. You can do that several times in one use.
No effect on undead or constructs.

name: Divine Smite
trigger: You hit with a melee weapon attack
description: On a melee weapon hit, spend a paladin spell slot to add radiant damage.
It is 2d8 with a 1st-level slot, plus 1d8 for every slot level above 1st, capped at 5d8. Undead and fiends take another 1d8.

name: Cleansing Touch
description: As an action, end a spell that is affecting you or a willing creature you touch.
You get as many uses as your Charisma modifier (at least 1). A long rest restores them.

name: Channel Divinity
uses: 1 use, refills on short or long rest
description: Your oath gives you divine effects you can trigger. You get 1 use, and each effect costs it. Effects with a save use your paladin spell save DC.
A short or long rest gives the use back.

name: Sacred Weapon
description: Imbue a weapon you hold with holy energy for 1 minute. Add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attack rolls with it.

It sheds bright light in 20 ft and dim light 20 ft further, and counts as magical if it was not. You can end it on your turn as part of another action. It also ends if you drop it or fall unconscious.

name: Turn the Unholy
description: Hold up your holy symbol and pray. Every fiend and undead within 30 ft that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC.

Failures are turned for 1 minute, ending early if they take damage. A turned creature runs from you, can't voluntarily end up within 30 ft, and gets no reactions. Its action can only be Dash, or escaping something that holds it; with no room to flee, it Dodges.

name: Holy Nimbus
description: Sunlight radiates from you for 1 minute: bright light in 30 ft and dim light 30 ft beyond.
An enemy that starts its turn in the bright light takes 10 radiant damage. You also have advantage on saves against spells cast by fiends and undead.
Once used, it needs a long rest.

name: Nature's Wrath
description: Conjure spectral vines that rise around one creature you can see within 10 ft. It makes a Strength or Dexterity save (its pick) against your spell save DC, and on a fail it is restrained.
The target saves again every time its own turn ends; passing frees it and the vines disappear.

name: Turn the Faithless
description: Utter ancient words that hurt fey and fiends. Each one within 30 ft that hears you makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC.

Failures are turned for 1 minute or until damaged. They flee, can't voluntarily come within 30 ft of you, and get no reactions. Their action is limited to Dash or escaping a hold, or Dodge when cornered.
A turned creature loses any illusion or shapeshift hiding its true form.

name: Undying Sentinel
trigger: You are reduced to 0 hit points
description: When damage drops you to 0 hit points without killing you outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead.
Works once, then needs a long rest.

name: Elder Champion
description: Use your action to become a primal force of nature for 1 minute, with an appearance you choose.

Each of your turns starts with 10 hit points regained. Any paladin spell that takes 1 action to cast takes a bonus action instead. Enemies within 10 ft have disadvantage on saves against your paladin spells and Channel Divinity.
Recharges on a long rest.

name: Abjure Enemy
description: Present your holy symbol and denounce a creature you can see within 60 ft. It makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. Fiends and undead roll at disadvantage, and creatures immune to fright are unaffected.

On a fail, it is frightened for 1 minute or until hurt. While frightened it can't move (speed 0) or use speed bonuses. On a success, it only has half speed, with the same 1-minute limit and the same end on damage.

name: Vow of Enmity
description: Pick one visible creature 10 ft or less from you and swear a vow against it. For 1 minute your attack rolls against it have advantage. The vow ends early if the target falls unconscious or reaches 0 hit points.

name: Relentless Avenger
description: Chase down a fleeing foe: when your opportunity attack lands, the same reaction lets you move up to half your speed straight after it. Nobody gets opportunity attacks on you for that move.

name: Soul of Vengeance
trigger: A creature under your Vow of Enmity attacks
description: If a creature bound by your Vow of Enmity attacks, spend your reaction to strike it with a melee weapon attack, as long as it is in your reach.

name: Avenging Angel
description: Transform into an angel of vengeance for 1 hour. Wings let you fly at 60 ft.

A 30 ft aura of menace also surrounds you. The first time an enemy enters it, or starts a turn inside it during a fight, that enemy makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. A fail frightens it of you for 1 minute or until damaged, and attacks against it have advantage.
Recharges on a long rest.

name: Control Undead
description: Target one undead you can see within 30 ft. It makes a Wisdom save; on a fail it obeys your commands for 24 hours, or until you use this option again.
Undead with a challenge rating at least your paladin level are immune.

name: Dreadful Aspect
description: Each creature you choose within 30 ft that can see you makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you for 1 minute.
A frightened creature that ends its turn over 30 ft from you can save again to end the effect.

name: Dread Lord
description: Action: wrap yourself in an aura of gloom, 30-ft radius, for 1 minute. Bright light inside it drops to dim light.

An enemy frightened of you that starts its turn in the aura takes 4d10 psychic damage. You and any creatures you choose in the aura are cloaked in shadow, so attackers that depend on sight roll at disadvantage against them.
While it lasts, a bonus action on your turn makes the shadows strike one creature: a melee spell attack that deals 3d10 + your Charisma modifier necrotic damage on a hit.
Once used, it needs a long rest.

name: Champion Challenge
description: Each creature you choose that you can see within 30 ft makes a Wisdom save. On a fail, it won't willingly go farther than 30 ft from you.
The hold on a creature breaks once you die or become incapacitated, or once it is moved over 30 ft from you.
The book names no action type for this option; it is usually played as an action, like other Channel Divinity options.

name: Turn the Tide
description: Bonus action: every creature you choose within 30 ft that can hear you, and has no more than half its hit points, regains 1d6 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) hit points.

name: Divine Allegiance
trigger: A creature no more than 5 ft away is damaged
description: Use your reaction to take the damage in its place, so it takes none. Nothing can reduce or prevent the damage you take this way.

name: Exalted Champion
description: Action: for 1 hour you gain these benefits, ending early if you are incapacitated or die:
• You have resistance to nonmagical weapon damage of the bludgeoning, piercing and slashing kinds.
• Your allies within 30 ft of you have advantage on death saving throws.
• You, and your allies within 30 ft of you, have advantage on Wisdom saving throws.
Once used, it needs a long rest.

name: Conquering Presence
description: Pick any number of creatures in sight and no more than 30 ft away; each makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it is frightened of you for 1 minute. It can save again whenever one of its turns ends, ending the fear on a success.

name: Guided Strike
description: Add +10 to the roll. Choose to do so once you have seen the roll, as long as the DM hasn't yet announced a hit or a miss.

name: Aura of Conquest
trigger: A creature frightened of you starts its turn in your aura
description: While you aren't incapacitated, a menacing aura spreads 10 ft around you (30 ft from paladin level 18). Total cover blocks it.
A creature frightened of you has speed 0 while in the aura, and if it starts its turn there it takes psychic damage: half your paladin level.

name: Scornful Rebuke
trigger: A creature hits you with an attack
description: If you aren't incapacitated, the attacker suffers psychic damage: your Charisma modifier, minimum 1. No action is needed.

name: Invincible Conqueror
description: Action: you become an avatar of conquest for 1 minute, gaining:
• Resistance to all damage.
• Your Attack action on your turn includes one more attack.
• Your melee weapon attacks are critical hits on a d20 roll of 19 or 20.
Once used, it needs a long rest.

name: Emissary of Peace
description: For the next 10 minutes you gain +5 on Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

name: Rebuke the Violent
trigger: An attacker within 30 ft damages a creature other than you with an attack
description: Right after that damage, the attacker makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it suffers radiant damage matching what it just dealt; on a success, half that.

name: Aura of the Guardian
trigger: A creature within 10 ft of you (30 ft from level 18) takes damage
description: Your reaction magically shifts that damage onto you instead. Only the damage moves to you, not any other effect that came with it, and nothing can lower the damage you take.

name: Protective Spirit
trigger: Your turn ends in combat while you are below half your hit points
description: If you aren't incapacitated, you heal 1d6 + half your paladin level.

name: Emissary of Redemption
trigger: A creature hits you with an attack
description: You resist all damage that other creatures deal you, whether from attacks, spells or other effects.
An attacker that hits you suffers radiant damage worth half of what the hit did to you.
Both benefits stop working against a creature you attack, target with a spell or harm in any other way (this feature aside), until your next long rest.

name: Additional Paladin Spells
description: Adds Tasha's extra spells to the Paladin list, so you can prepare them as paladin spells.
They carry an Optional tag wherever they show.
